description: Frozen S&P 500 membership fixtures: one name = one vintage, immutable, never edited. A new vintage gets a new name and a new file. Used by tests, GitHub CI and evidence replays through ggTrader.data.membership.FixtureMembershipSource (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-07-membership-database-design.md, section 4). `path` is relative to the repository root; `gz_sha256` is the sha256 of the file as committed, `raw_sha256` of its uncompressed bytes, `content_sha256` the canonical content hash (spec 1.4). `db_load_id_on_encom` is the load id of the same vintage in the production database on Encom (informational: load ids differ between databases, the content hash is the identity).

sp500_v1_2026-06-02.note: Vintage 1. Committed 2026-06-09 as f8c7efe0; the true retrieval time and upstream commit are unknown. The bytes stay frozen at this path because the event-timing audit pins them (decision D4).
